title: Apply Config Change Result
description: Return of the apply-config-change agent: the pb key it was given, any open ambiguity, the proposed commit subject and the files it changed

pb_key.description: The key from the prompt, copied exactly

ambiguity.description: An open question the task left unresolved, or an empty string

commit_subject.description: Proposed commit subject line for the change

files_changed.description: Repo-relative paths of files the agent modified
